aspect: The visit is a full-day operation
description: Coach at dawn, several checkpoints, a search, a wait, then a short visit through glass, then the return. A visit measured in minutes costs a day, every time.

aspect: The permit can fail at any point in the chain
description: Approved in advance, refused at the gate, on grounds not given. The day is spent either way and so is the money.
energy_note: Turned back at the last door, with no reason.

description: Children over a certain age are frequently barred, so a parent must choose which child comes, or explain to a child why they are the one who cannot.
energy_note: Choosing which of your children sees their father.

aspect: The role is gendered and unpaid
description: The mothers, wives, sisters and daughters run the visits, the lawyer contact, the canteen money and the appeals, on top of the household they are now the sole manager of.
time_note: Days per year on visits and prisoner administration.
energy_note: An unpaid second job with no end date.
